items.title: Package managers have an integrity problem
items.blurb: I tested 25 of the most popular package managers to check whether they detect a compromised package repository injecting malicious code into legitimate packages. Only two verified the integrity of every package they downloaded.

items.title: The Best Way to Use Icons in Web UIs

items.title: Living in the Weimar era of Ruby
